name: mirage
text: You don't, and that was a design flaw. The engine's Kalshi switch meant both 'look at Kalshi' and 'bet', so OFF scanned nothing. I changed it. With the switch OFF, the engine now scans Kalshi and lists the bets, but places no bets or bids and sends no orders. Paper and Live are still the only modes that act. The change is in the code and checked by a test. The engine uses it from its next start, which is within a few hours at its next handover. After that, Kalshi bets should appear in the +EV list under the Kalshi chip with nothing else changed on your side.
